description: Defines the class 'phy_metrics_crc_calculator_decorator', a decorator for CRC calculator that adds metrics reporting and resource usage measurement.

classes.name: phy_metrics_crc_calculator_decorator
classes.description: A decorator class for CRC calculator that reports metrics and measures resource usage.

methods.name: calculate_byte
methods.description: Calculates CRC for byte data, reports metrics, and measures CPU usage.

methods.name: calculate_bit
methods.description: Calculates CRC for bit data, reports metrics, and measures CPU usage.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates CRC for bit buffer data, reports metrics, and measures CPU usage.

methods.name: get_generator_poly
methods.description: Returns the generator polynomial used by the CRC calculator.
